title: Demote tianming-novel-agent to a pure adapter layer

meta.adjudication: The novel domain is owned by C#. This was not an open question: the five 08-30 children completed on 2026-09-01 and landed the control plane, tenant RLS, fenced worker, Canon merge and SSE in C#, with real-PostgreSQL E2E coverage. The TypeScript package holds a parallel, unwired shadow implementation of the same domain.

evidence.csharpDomainOwnership: AgentControlDbContext 23 files, KernelTask 84, CandidateChapter 62, CanonBranch 59, ProductionBatch 37, GoalProposal 20; 61 EF migrations; RLS defined across 10 MigrationsPostgres files including EnableTenantRls, EnforceTenantRlsAndActiveTaskGraph, EnableBookProductionTenantRls.
evidence.tsUnwired: Zero importers repo-wide. No Process.Start, no Node host package, no queue bridge. The single HTTP-to-Node path (Program.cs:309 PiConversationAgentRuntime to :4317) targets the legacy Pi runtime and is disabled at appsettings.json:53.
evidence.tsShadow: src/contracts.ts is 678 of 1676 LOC and hand-mirrors C# domain types; src/domain/continuity-gate.ts is 62 lines against the authoritative 901-line 6-gate C# ChapterGatekeeper.
evidence.noGate: package.json defines build/test/type-check but no CI runs them; the repo root has no .github/. Requirement exists only as prose at .trellis/spec/backend/database-guidelines.md:234-240.

rejectedAlternatives.deleteThePackage: Discards the genuine adapter and loop wiring; AGENT_CORE_ARCHITECTURE.md section 7 migration order still stands.
rejectedAlternatives.keepAsUnwiredTargetState: Would create a second TargetArchitectureDirector: a registered-but-unwired component that becomes a recurring source of confusion. Repeating a known failure.

meta.staleContextRisk: tianming-novel-agent/dist/ is gitignored (.gitignore:39) but 2-3.5h staler than src, and still carries dist/src/store/in-memory-store.{js,d.ts} whose source was deleted in commit 6564aaa9. Reading dist/ as current state already caused one wrong architectural claim in this project.
